newsitem.title: FRANCE: BoF's Gerard says Ffr/dlr rate now good balance.
newsitem.headline: BoF's Gerard says Ffr/dlr rate now good balance.

text.p: An exchange rate of between 5.75 and 5.90 francs to the dollar is a good balance, Bank of France Monetary Policy Committee member Jean-Pierre Gerard said in a newspaper interview to be published on Thursday.
"A good balance is about where we are, about 1.73 or 1.74 marks (to the dollar) or in franc terms between 5.75 and 5.90," Gerard said in an interview with financial daily l'Agefi.
"But it is true that what would be more favourable for us would be 6.20 francs," he added.
The dollar was worth 5.8145 francs and 1.7320 marks at 1802 GMT on Wednesday.
